name: Conflict at Darkspear Islands
summary: A Horde Warbringer calls you to answer the Theramore Expeditionary Force on the Darkspear Islands. Their reinforcements keep strengthening their position, and the Horde demands proof of victory.

sections.title: The Call
sections.body: A Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds asks you to bring back three Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor. The Theramore Expeditionary Force keeps sending reinforcements to strengthen its position on the islands. The Horde calls this a key battleground, and the Warbringer seeks evidence of victory there.

faq.answer: The Theramore Expeditionary Force continues to send reinforcements to bolster its position on the Darkspear Islands.

faq.q: What does the Horde Warbringer want?
faq.answer: A Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds asks you to bring three Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor as evidence of victory.

faq.q: Where do I take the Marks of Honor?
faq.answer: Bring the three Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

faq.q: Why does the Horde call this a key battleground?
faq.answer: The Theramore Expeditionary Force keeps sending reinforcements to bolster its position on the Darkspear Islands.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you are asked to show its might against the Theramore Expeditionary Force and bring back evidence of victory.

attribution: In-game quest text: Conflict at Darkspear Islands
